setup: [a text says the player has won a draw from [institution] that they never entered]
ask: [the message, in the name of [institution], asks for a tax or processing fee to be paid first, and a copy of an ID, before the prize can be released this week]
usualEnding: The fee is paid and a second fee follows. The prize never arrives, and the ID copy is used elsewhere.
realTwin: A real reward notice from a loyalty programme the player signed up for appears inside that programme's own app, with nothing to pay first.
